read.thesis: Q3 comp +4% beat plan and FY sales raised to $63.8-64.0B, but Q4 EPS cut on fuel and Marmaxx margin fell 110bp to 13.8%; off-price supply is loose with inventory per store flat.

triggers.label: FY sales raised to $63.8-64.0B
triggers.quote: We are increasing our full-year consolidated sales guidance to a range of $63.8 billion-$64 billion, up 6% versus last year.

triggers.label: Q4 EPS cut on fuel costs
triggers.quote: Again, this is lower than our previously implied guidance due to higher expected fuel costs.

triggers.label: Marmaxx margin down 110bp
triggers.quote: Marmaxx's adjusted segment profit margin was 13.8%, down 110 basis points versus last year, primarily driven by higher freight and fuel costs.

triggers.label: Inventory per store flat
triggers.quote: inventory on a per-store basis was flat versus last year

guidance.quote: we now expect overall comp sales to increase by 4%
We are increasing our full-year consolidated sales guidance to a range of $63.8 billion-$64 billion
We are planning adjusted pre-tax profit margin to be in the range of 12%-12.1%
We continue to expect full-year adjusted gross margin to be in the range of 31.2%-31.3%
we expect our full-year diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $5.17-$5.20
we are planning overall comp sales to be up 2%-3%
